about: W41 part 3 blind set (Wed Oct 28 2026): written by a Claude Sonnet 5.5 agent told never to open the repo, so it never read core/src/trust/ or the reader's prompt. 60 scam asks (25 off-PayPal, 12 gift card, 13 instructing the agent, 10 writing memory or limits) and 40 fair notes. Measured before any change, twice with the same tallies: code alone 19 of 60 asks clear; code plus the AI reader 0 of 60 (docs/fixtures/reader-r4.json). The Watcher's rules were not tuned on it. Now that it is in the repo and in the escalation check, it is used up as a blind set: the next re-measure needs a new writer (r5).
